title: Anadolu Efes are ING BSL champions
description: Fenerbahce - Anadolu Efes 66-93 Anadolu Efes are 20/21 ING BSL champions. They breezed past Fenerbahce in the third game of the championship series to complete the sweep and lift the trophy. The guests trailed by 4 points after first quarter, but they stormed back to get the 12-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 93-66. Anadolu Efes dominated on the defensive end, holding Fenerbahce to just 7 points in second quarter. They outrebounded Fenerbahce 33-20 including 24 on the defensive glass. Anadolu Efes looked well-organized offensively handing out 24 assists. The best player for the winners was French guard Rodrigue Beaubois (190-88, agency: BeoBasket) who scored 30 points and 4 assists (on 11-of-13 shooting from the field).
